dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md, reference file, and shell wrapper consistently describe B2B lead/company search and email discovery or validation through fixed Generect API endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The activation text is somewhat broad for prospecting and enrichment workflows, and the artifacts do not add an explicit privacy or consent warning, but the external API use and data categories are visible in the documentation and examples.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The core artifact has no hidden installer; it includes a simple shell wrapper. The documentation also mentions optional MCP alternatives, including an unpinned npx package and remote MCP endpoint, which users should evaluate separately before using.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires a GENERECT_API_KEY and transmits caller-provided JSON to Generect, which is proportionate for an external enrichment API but can include personal or business prospecting data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence shows persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local credential harvesting, file mutation, destructive actions, or broad local data access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The routing is broad within sales/prospecting use cases, but it is still tied to Generect lead, company, enrichment, and email workflows rather than unrelated tasks; this is a user-guidance issue, not a Review-level concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Names, emails, domains, LinkedIn URLs, and company information may be sent to Generect, but this is the documented function of the API wrapper; the lack of an explicit privacy warning should be handled with installation guidance.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the prospecting data you provide to Generect. Use a dedicated API key, avoid submitting regulated or unnecessary personal data, check your legal basis for lead enrichment or outreach, and review the separate MCP package or remote MCP endpoint before using those optional paths.
llm.summary: This is a straightforward Generect API helper that sends user-provided lead, company, LinkedIn, and email lookup data to Generect as its documented purpose.
